title: Eval sentinel for pinned model transitions
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Summary:
Design and ship an "eval sentinel" that automatically runs targeted quality checks when a model version is pinned, unpinned, or upgraded in the catalog or on customer-pinned deployments. The sentinel should orchestrate lightweight, workload-aware evals (unit prompt sets and a small holdout of production-like prompts) prior to promoting a pin change to live traffic; surface regressions to the Console and trigger configured rollout policies (block, canary, auto-rollback).

Background and motivation:
Customers regularly pin model versions (catalog or private pins) to avoid surprise regressions. Currently model pin/upgrade workflows lack consistent, automatic preflight checks that run at the moment of the pin event — this leads to manual evals, delayed rollouts, and occasionally missed regressions. We need a defensible, automated pattern that balances speed, coverage, and cost.

What this ticket covers:
- Define the sentinel contract for pin events (catalog vs customer pin namespaces).
- Wire event triggers from the catalog and from customer pin operations into the eval orchestration system.
- Provide two evaluation profiles: "smoke" (fast, small token limits) and "regression-check" (broader but still sub-minute).
- Integrate with Console UI to show sentinel results and recommended actions (approve, require canary, block).
- Emit telemetry (per-pin eval latency, pass/fail, delta metrics) and create alerting rules for high-severity regressions.

Non-goals:
- Full-scale continuous evaluation that replicates nightly eval rigs.
- Replacing manual, deep-eval workflows used by model owners for major releases.

Stakeholders:
- Product: Maya Patel (owner), Riley Chen (PM execution)
- Eng: Infra/Serving (ENG-2411 lead), Evals team (ENG-8742 collaborator)
- DX/Design: notify for console surfaces
- Security: opt-in for private pins that require KMS/approval flows

Progress and decisions so far:
- Feb 12: Kickoff with infra and evals teams; agreed on two eval profiles and that sentinel should be asynchronous but able to block promotion if configured by customer.
- Feb 18: Draft API contract for pin-event webhook created; small feedback loop with ENG-2411.
- Feb 23: Design review for Console panel; PM/Design requested clearer failure semantics (show token-level diffs and sample outputs).
- Mar 02: Decided that sentinel results will attach to pin events as an immutable evaluation artifact (so customers can reference specific eval runs).

Open questions:
- Default policy for hosted catalog pins: auto-run smoke evals and mark results, but do not block (customer choice). For enterprise private pins, default to blocking until smoke eval passes — need legal/security approval?
- How large should the "regression-check" prompt set be for high-risk customers? Bandwidth/cost trade-offs need product thresholds.

Next steps (dev handoff):
- Finalize event schema and wire the event to eval runner (ENG) — target: 2026-02-20 for initial PR.
- Build Console UI tile and pin-level timeline entry to show eval artifacts — design mocks in Confluence (link below).
- Add telemetry metrics and alerting for false positives and timeouts.

Acceptance criteria:
- When a pin/upgrade action occurs (catalog or customer-pinned), an eval sentinel triggers an eval run with the appropriate profile.
- Eval run artifacts are stored and linked to the pin event (immutable ID).
- Console surfaces the sentinel status (pending/success/fail/timeout) in the pin detail view.
- Admins can configure per-customer pin policy: notify-only | require-smoke-pass | require-regression-pass.
- In the case of failures, a recommended rollout policy (canary, rollback) is displayed and an optional automatic canary is schedulable.
- Telemetry shows per-pin eval latency, pass rate, and top regression categories.

Implementation notes:
- Event wiring: extend the pin-change event bus with a new "pin.eval.requested" event carrying pin metadata and customer policy flags.
- Eval runner: use existing eval harness but run in limited mode. Limit token caps and wall time (smoke < 30s, regression-check < 90s).
- Storage: eval artifacts stored in the evals blobstore with cross-reference keys in the metadata DB.
- Console: new panel that fetches eval artifacts by pin ID and renders a compact diff + sample outputs; also shows suggested actions.
- Policy enforcement: gating occurs in the control-plane promotion flow; if require-smoke-pass is enabled and smoke fails, promotion is blocked and a remediation action is returned.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Sentinel must trigger an eval for each pin/upgrade event and attach an immutable artifact ID to the pin record.
2) Console shows sentinel status and links to artifact, with sample outputs and metric diffs.
3) Admins can set pin policies per customer: notify-only | require-smoke-pass | require-regression-pass.
4) If require-* is set and eval fails, promotion is blocked and an explicit remediation action is surfaced.
5) Telemetry emitted for triggers, run duration, pass/fail, and token cost estimates.
implementation_notes:
- Use event name 'pin.eval.requested' on the control-plane event bus.
- Eval runner to accept profile name and run_id; enforce strict time and token budgets.
- Attach eval artifact metadata to pin DB record and write audit log entry.
- Provide lightweight SDK hook for customers to attach custom prompt sets to their pin (optional).
- Ensure encryption at rest for artifacts linked to private pins.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal opt-in (notify-only). Phase 1: beta customers with require-smoke-pass. Phase 2: opt-in for catalog owners; defaults remain notify-only. Provide rollback path and admin override. Monitor telemetry daily during beta and extend policies based on false positive rate.
metrics:
- daily_eval_triggers: count
- eval_latency_ms: p50/p95
- eval_pass_rate_by_model: percentage
- pins_blocked_by_eval: count
- avg_tokens_per_eval_profile: number
- monthly_estimated_cost_per_1k_pins: USD
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: High false-positive rate leading to unnecessary blocks. Mitigation: default to notify-only for most customers; allow enterprise opt-in for blocking and tune prompt sets.
Risk: Eval runner cost spike. Mitigation: strict token/time caps and quota per customer.
Risk: Latency on pin operations if blocking. Mitigation: sentinel operates asynchronously for notify-only mode; blocking mode returns a clear expected time window and supports canary instead of full block.
qa_and_test_plan:
- Unit tests for event wiring and artifact attachments.
- Load test that simulates 500 concurrent pin events (ensure queueing and rate-limits).
- End-to-end test with a sample model that we intentionally regress to validate blocking and rollback flows.
- Beta run with internal org and 3 external customers to validate UX and false-positive rates.
